name: Reading an installation setting from deployment.private.json
summary: admin.deployment_document opens only a regular file (a FIFO or directory is refused at once) and returns the JSON object, raising ConfigurationUnreadable otherwise. Each setting reader takes its key from it and reads a value of the wrong type as its safe default with a warning naming the setting (admin.coordinator_rules, admin.review_workflow_writes, task_files.limits); a typo never lifts a limit.
